verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs confirm an integrated real-time ledger and mention that its in-house team handles 'daily reconciliation, settlement, and more' (highnote-docs-3, highnote-docs-23, highnote-docs-33, highnote-docs-19), suggesting reconciliation data is tracked and accessible via API. However, there is no explicit evidence of dedicated settlement-file exports or report APIs itemizing interchange, fees, and network adjustments for finance-stack consumption — reconciliation is described as an internal Highnote process rather than a documented finance-facing artifact/API. Missing for 10: explicit settlement/reconciliation report API or file schema, interchange/fee/network-adjustment breakdown fields, and confirmation these are consumable by external finance systems (e.g., ERP/GL exports).
